filename: Non‐Linear Dimensionality Reduction With a Variational Encoder Decoder to Understand Convective Processes in Climate Models - Behrens - 2022 - Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems - Wiley Online Library.pdf
title: Non-Linear Dimensionality Reduction With a Variational Encoder Decoder to Understand Convective Processes in Climate Models
venue: Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems
parameterization_target: total diabatic heating and moistening tendencies (dT/dt, dq/dt), surface and top-of-atmosphere radiative fluxes (SW, LW), and precipitation rate
testbed_rationale: Uses the standard CBRAIN-CAM benchmark configuration for ML atmospheric convection parameterization based on SPCAM, with full open-source code and documented preprocessed data pipelines.
pain_points: High dimensionality of standard deep neural network parameterizations limits interpretability and trust.
Lower tropospheric moistening tendencies in the subtropics remain difficult to reproduce accurately due to stochastic variability.
Trade-off between latent space compression (e.g. 5 nodes) and accuracy relative to uncompressed overparameterized neural networks.
extraction_notes: The network is an offline parameterization emulator mapping large-scale resolved atmospheric state variables to subgrid tendencies as well as reconstructing the input states to ensure latent space interpretability.
